chapter: Lew Tabackin and the move to Los Angeles
title: Marrying Lew and the Tonight Show years
summary: They married while Lew worked with Doc Severinsen's group; the move to Los Angeles followed.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yep. That year was 1969? That correct?

Because he had … Doc Severinsen had a small band to go up, so he was a member of that, had like six singers or something, that kind of thing. And uh, and then they moved to Los Angeles. So that brought us to move to Los Angeles, ‟72, summer. And, at that time I decided I was going to quit because I, because … I didn‟t really make any impact, you know. I tried hard, I had my concert, got a good review and everything, but it didn‟t really change my life. And uh … so I decided maybe I should quit, because the world doesn‟t need another piano player, you know [chuckles].
